items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: The interviewer mentions Bill Packer as a bass player associated with the group, but the interviewee does not confirm a personal relationship or specific role with Packer, only confirming the presence of other band members.

ctx.x: Valtuli on the violin. That's Buddy Christian, guitar. Buddy Christian, guitar. And that's Frankie Keeling. Frankie Keeling. And that's Zeno. Henry Zeno is the drummer. Henry Zeno. And I think that's Packer. What's his name? Bass player. Bill Packer. Wasn't he a bass player? Bill Packer. Who's the drum man? Bill Packer's the drum player. Who's that bass player, Papa? Ike. Ike something. Ike Jackson. Was that Ike Jackson? Playing with your Pete? Yeah. Was it Ike Jackson? Mm-hmm.
